name: tre-builder
description: TRE Builder — stand up a compliant Trusted Research Environment (TRE) on Snowflake with one governed, phased deploy. Vacuum-deployable into an isolated database, seeded from a brand-neutral synthetic SAMPLE_OMOP dataset, enforcing the Five Safes (Safe People/Projects/Settings/Data/Outputs) via policy-as-code and a native output airlock. Each phase deploys, proves its controls (positive + negative tests), then advances; clean teardown. Targets SATRE conformance. Phase 1: RBAC, edition gate, SAMPLE_OMOP, Five Safes policy pack, output airlock, in-perimeter Cortex agent.
